claims.evidence: Witness photos show Nikon-branded boxes and a camera with a long lens, but the exact model (D750) is not readable.
No clear close-up of body condition, scratches, or wear; lens condition details are obscured by bubble wrap.
Photos do not show a powered-on test, autofocus/zoom/button checks, or image output.
No shutter count screen/EXIF/Camera settings page is shown.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens is not shown in a clear, unwrapped close-up; details are obscured.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Box contents are bubble-wrapped and exact included items (battery/charger type) are not clearly visible.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (e.g., not actually D750) or different Nikon body/lens kit than claimed; pricing depends heavily on the exact model and whether it’s body-only vs kit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/serial label on the body (and/or the box label) plus a photo of the lens model name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR body with unknown model and unknown kit completeness (worst-case within what’s visible).

risks.risk: Not actually working (dead pixels, shutter issues, autofocus/zoom failure, port faults).
risks.proof: A short video of the camera powered on showing: live view, autofocus lock on a target, zoom/controls working, and a saved photo preview.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until a functional test is shown.

risks.risk: Lens condition worse than claimed (fungus, haze, scratches, separation).
risks.proof: Unwrapped, close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element under light (including edge-to-edge clarity).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition unknown and potentially impaired.

risks.risk: Shutter count not truly under 5,000 (could be much higher).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the shutter count from-camera or a reliable shutter count app screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher usage than claimed.

risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo showing every included item (battery model, charger model, cables, strap, lens hood, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (missing some accessories).

risks.risk: Authenticity/parts mismatch (non-original battery/charger, refurbished parts, swapped components).
risks.proof: Photos of battery/charger labels (brand/model/serial) and the camera serial number; plus a receipt/warranty card if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible non-original accessories.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera model (D750) and serial number label on the body (and matching box label).
Unwrapped close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements under bright light (edge-to-edge).
A short powered-on video showing live view, autofocus lock, zoom/controls, and saving/reviewing a photo.
A screenshot/photo of shutter count from-camera or a shutter-count tool screen.
A full laid-out photo of all included accessories (battery model, charger model, cables, strap, lens hood, manuals) with counts.
response.reason: The witness confirms Nikon packaging and a camera with a long lens, but the exact model (D750), working status, shutter count, and lens condition are not verifiable from the photos. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
